art_note: Standard e-commerce renders with flat pattern placement lack high-end luxury editorial mood.
desc_en: This thong redefines intimate elegance with a refined design and delicate lace details. Crafted from a lightweight blend, it offers an impeccable silhouette and exceptional comfort for everyday wear. The elastic waistband gently adapts to the figure. Each piece is made to order with worldwide shipping.
desc_es: Esta tanga redefine la elegancia íntima con un diseño depurado y detalles de encaje delicados. Confeccionada con una mezcla ligera, ofrece una silueta impecable y una comodidad excepcional para el día a día. La cintura elástica se adapta con suavidad a la figura. Cada pieza se elabora bajo pedido con envíos a todo el mundo.
details_en:
· Composition: 95% polyester and 5% spandex
· Fabric weight: 180g/m²
· Comfortable elastic waistband
· Lace trim along the top
· Made to order
· Worldwide shipping available
details_es:
